Commentary.Commentary: Right then! That is it from the coverage of the one-off T20I between India Women and New Zealand Women. The five-match ODI series between these two sides is set to kick off on Saturday, 12th February. The first ODI will begin at 3.30 am IST (10 pm GMT, previous night). Do join us then and make sure you tune in early for the buildup. Till then, goodbye and take care!

Sophie Devine, the skipper of New Zealand Women, says it is a good feeling to win the series and the ladies played really well. Mentions the way they laid the foundation for players like Tahuhu who batted really well was good and the bowlers were also excellent. Ends by saying it is now time to adapt to the 50-over format and they are looking forward for it.

Harmanpreet Kaur, the skipper of India Women, says that they were in the game when they were bowling but they conceded a lot of runs towards the end and they needed more partnerships while batting. Adds they have learnt a lot and they will look to improve. Also says playing at the same venue will help them.

Lea Tahuhu is the PLAYER OF THE MATCH. She says that she batting at number 5 was a plan. Adds she is trying to become an all-rounder but she isn't there yet. Mentions it was a good game and they are happy to get over the line.
... THE PRESENTATION ...

The Indians, needed someone to go on big. They had a few of them who got off to starts but nobody could make most of it. There was just far too much for the lower order to do and they failed to pull off a miracle.

The Kiwis did not manage to take a wicket in the Powerplay but did not let India score freely. Also, whenever the visitors looked to up the ante, the Kiwis managed to pick wickets. Regular breakthroughs just made it tough and in the end the tourists fell well short. Probably all the bowlers except for Rowe will be happy with their performances. Can’t really pick one, just have to say it has been a collective effort from the Kiwis.
A very convincing win then for the hosts and they have won the one-off T20I. After a collective effort with the bat, they managed to get past the 150-run mark and have defended it well.
Just the single! This is a full ball, around off. Poonam Yadav drives it towards the fielder at extra cover and manages only a run. New Zealand Women win the one-off T20I by 18 runs!

OUT! BOWLED! Jess Kerr has the last laugh! A slower ball, on a length, around off. Simran Bahadur shimmies down to go downtown but fails to get any bat on it. The ball goes past her blade and knocks the stumps over. Poonam Yadav walks out to bat.
FOUR! Too little, too late for India Women! A length ball, around off. Simran Bahadur skips down and lofts it over the mid off fielder for a boundary. 20 runs needed off 2 balls.
Fuller in length, outside off. Deepti Sharma drives it towards Suzie Bates at mid off and takes off for a single. Bates collects the ball and has a shy at the bowler's end but she misses.
Full ball, outside off. Simran Bahadur carves it through the cover region but manages only a run.
FOUR! Clever from Simran Bahadur! This is a low full toss, around off. Simran Bahadur moves across and scoops it over the short fine leg fielder for a boundary.
Back of a length, outside off. Simran Bahadur punches it towards cover and takes a single.
Wide! Full ball, well outside off. Simran Bahadur lets it be and the umpire calls it as a wide.
Back of a length, around off. Simran Bahadur taps it towards backward point.
Good-length ball, around middle. Deepti Sharma looks to heave it away but it goes off the top edge, in the air and luckily for Sharma it falls safely in the vacant mid-wicket region. A single taken.
Wide! Another ball, angling down leg. Deepti Sharma misses her nudge on the leg side and the umpire signals a wide.

OUT! CAUGHT! A slower ball, into the wicket, around off. Pooja Vastrakar looks to go over mid off but ends up chipping it towards Sophie Devine who backtracks a bit and takes a sharp catch. India Women slip further. Simran Bahadur walks out to bat now.
Commentary.Howout: c Suzie Bates b Hayley Jensen

Commentary.Commentary: Good-length ball, around middle. Deepti Sharma drags it towards deep mid-wicket for a single.
Wide! A length ball, angling down leg. Deepti Sharma misses her flick and the umpire signals a wide.

OUT! CAUGHT BEHIND! What a stunner from Katey Martin behind the sticks! This was a length ball, angling down leg. Sneh Rana gets low and looks to just help it on its way. The ball brushes the glove and goes towards the keeper. Katey Martin dives low to her left and takes a good catch. Deepti Sharma walks out to bat.
Commentary.Howout: c Katey Martin b Hayley Jensen

Commentary.Commentary: A single! On the pads, Rana looks to pull, it goes off the top edge fine on the leg side for one.
Misses out. She steps out and makes it into a full toss but hits it to covers for one.
Floats it up, this is hit hard again but to covers.
FOUR! India need it to rain boundaries now! On off, Pooja steps out and hits it through covers for a boundary.
Leading edge but safe! On middle, Rana looks to flick, it goes off the leading edge on the leg side for one.
That was a dangerous shot! It is on middle, Pooja looks to cut, she gets an inside edge towards short fine leg for one.
A single to end! 44 needed now in three. Pooja comes down the track and looks to go over covers, this goes off the outside edge down to third man for one.
Singles won't do it for India! On middle, this is worked through square leg.
Just short and a run out chance also goes begging. On middle, Sneh lifts it towards mid on. It goes on the bounce. Pooja backs up a long way. The fielder has a shy at the bowler's end but misses.
On middle, this is worked to mid-wicket.
Dots are something India can't afford! On off, this is pushed to covers.
EDGED BUT RUNS! Outside off, Rana opens the face of the bat, it runs more off the edge and just wide of the diving keeper for two.
A single to end! On off, this is pushed through covers for one.
Sneh Rana walks in at number 7.

OUT! TIMBER! The game now is slipping away from India. Richa looks to be innovative, she needed to find the fence and hence moves across. Sophie bowls it on off. Richa swings but misses. You miss, I hit from Devine.
SAFE AGAIN! Richa steps out and Sophie bowls another slower one. Richa is early in the loft, it goes off the bottom, wide of mid off for two.
Just over! A slower one. Pooja is way to early in the push, she hits it uppishly but over covers for one.
On the pads, this is worked through square leg for two.
On off, this is pushed through covers for one.

That is a beauty! Well kept too. Length and on off, this one jags back in. Pooja Vastrakar looks to defend but it goes between bat and pad and over middle. The keeper dives to her left and stops it with one hand.
Pooja Vastrakar walks out to bat.

OUT! TAKEN! Meghana falls, a good innings from her but she needed to go on. The partnership which was worrying the Kiwis has been broken! Length and on off, Meghana looks to go over covers. It goes off the higher part of the bat and it is taken by Suzie Bates at covers.
Commentary.Howout: c Suzie Bates b Lea Tahuhu

Commentary.Commentary: Two! Not from the middle of the bat but hit well enough. On middle, this is lofted down the ground. Two taken.
On middle, defended.
EDGY FOUR! India won't mind how they come as long as they do. Outside off, Meghana swings but it goes off the outside edge down to the third man fence.
On off, this is pushed to cover.
Just a single from it but a really good over for India. 61 runs needed off 36 balls. Shorter and outside off, this is guided through point for one.
WIDE! Short and on middle, Meghana looks to go over point but misses. Will the extra ball cost New Zealand Women?
FOUR! Smoked! India well and truly in this. Full and on off, this is smacked down past mid off for the second boundary in the over.
On middle, cramps the batter for room. Meghana guides it to point.
Two more! Fuller and outside off, Meghana lifts it over covers, it is more off the splice but enough to get over the fielder. Two taken.
FOUR! Up and over and all of a sudden it is raining boundaries. Short and outside off, it is cut over point for a boundary.
Outside off, shorter. Meghana slashes but misses.
FOUR! Short and put away and a productive over for India. 9 from it. 73 more needed. Shorter and outside off, this is cut through point for a boundary.
Now takes one by working it through square leg.
FOUR! That will release a little pressure. Hit really hard. She steps out, gets to the pitch of it and hammers it through covers for a boundary.
Three dots in a row! On off, this is hit hard to mid off.
On middle, this is worked to mid-wicket.
Meghana misses out! A full toss outside off, she hits it to covers.
Another dot to end! On middle, Richa plays it to mid-wicket.
This is not what India want, a dot! On middle, it is worked to mid-wicket.
FOUR! That has been cracked! Shorter and on the body, this is pulled wide of fine leg and into the boundary. Welcome boundary. India need more.
Short and outside off, Meghana upper cuts it down to third man for one.
No timing! Shorter and on middle, Richa looks to pull, it goes off the splice towards mid-wicket for one.
Shorter and on off, this is guided down to third man for one.
A dot to end, fuller and on off, this is pushed to covers.
Richa Ghosh walks out to bat.

OUT! TIMBER! Right through the gate and Kerr gets the big fish, the wicket which probably has turned the tide completely into the hosts' favor. That swung in beautifully. This starts well outside off and comes back in. Kaur looks to defend but leaves a big gap between bat and pad. The ball sneaks through and hits the off pole.
Two! Fuller and outside off, Kaur drives it through covers for two.
Fuller and on off, Meghana plays it through covers for one.
Drop and run! On off, Kaur plays it on the off side and takes one.
The paddle scoop, this one swings in from outside off. Kaur plays it fine on the leg side for two.
FOUR! Up and over, welcome boundary to end the over. On off, Meghana lifts it over covers for a boundary.
WIDE! Down the leg side, Meghnana looks to flick but misses.
On middle, this is worked to mid-wicket.
Just the one again as this is eased through covers.
A single as this is pushed through covers.
On middle, it is played back to the bowler.
A single as this is pushed through covers.
On off, this is pushed to covers.
Tossed up, around middle. Harmanpreet Kaur sweeps it towards deep square leg for a single.
Flatter ball, around leg. Sabbhineni Meghana pulls it without much timing towards deep square leg for a run.
Slightly shorter in length, outside off. Harmanpreet Kaur cuts it to sweeper cover for a single.
Flatter ball, on a length, around middle and leg. Sabbhineni Meghana tucks it to the leg side for a run.
Looped up, around middle. Harmanpreet Kaur sweeps it towards deep square leg for a single.
Good-length ball, outside off. Sabbhineni Meghana looks to poke at it but she misses.
FOUR! UP AND OVER! Effortless from Sabbhineni Meghana! A length ball, around off. Meghana prods and lofts it over the bowler's head for a boundary. Top shot!
Fuller in length, outside off. Harmanpreet Kaur looks to push it through the off side but it goes off the inside edge towards fine leg for a run.
Good-length delivery, around off. Harmanpreet Kaur punches it towards the cover-point fielder.
Good-length ball, outside off. Sabbhineni Meghana cuts it towards backward point where the fielder half-stops it and the batters take a single.
Back of a length, around off. Sabbhineni Meghana defends it off the back foot.
Tossed up, around off. Harmanpreet Kaur blocks it out. End of a successful over for New Zealand Women!

OUT! CAUGHT! Shafali Verma holes out! She would be absolutely gutted as this was a very loose ball. A half-tracker, around off. Verma rocks back and pulls it uppishly towards deep mid-wicket. Maddy Green there, takes a good catch just in front of the ropes. Both the openers are back in the hut now. Sabbhineni Meghana walks out to bat.
Commentary.Howout: c Maddy Green b Amelia Kerr

Commentary.Commentary: Flatter and quicker, around off. Harmanpreet Kaur punches it through the cover region for a single to get off the mark.
Harmanpreet Kaur walks in at number 3.

OUT! BOWLED! Yastika Bhatia is bowled around her legs! Big wicket this for New Zealand Women! Amelia Kerr serves a googly, outside the leg stump. Yastika Bhatia looks to sweep but she misses it completely and the ball knocks the stumps over.
Flatter ball, around middle. Shafali Verma nudges it to the leg side for a run.
A half-tracker, around leg. Yastika Bhatia pulls it towards deep mid-wicket and takes a single.
Short of a length, outside off. Shafali Verma cuts it to the fielder at point. India Women are 39/0 at the end of the Powerplay.

FOUR! Two in two for Shafali Verma! Not the most convincing though! This was a length ball, around middle. Verma heaves it across the line. The ball goes just wide of the diving fielder at mid-wicket for another boundary.
FOUR! Shafali Verma breaks the shackles! Back of a length, around off. Verma backs away and lofts it over the mid off fielder for a boundary.
Shorter in length, outside off. Shafali Verma cuts hard yet again but fails to find the gap. Three dots in a row!
Short of a length, outside off. Shafali Verma cuts hard but straight to the fielder at cover-point.
Good-length delivery, around off. Shafali Verma blocks it off the front foot.
On a length, around middle and leg. Yastika Bhatia whips it off her pads towards the deep square leg region. The fielder there cuts it off the and the batters take two runs.
Play and a miss! Good-length ball, around middle. Yastika Bhatia skips down to heave it away but she misses.

Top effort in the deep! Full ball, outside off. Yastika Bhatia slices it uppishly over the point region. The fielder in the deep runs across to her right and dives. She saves a couple of runs for her side.
On a length, around middle. Yastika Bhatia keeps it out watchfully.
FOUR! Width on offer and Yastika Bhatia makes full use of it! Fuller and wider, outside off. Yastika Bhatia prods and just chips it over the cover fielder. A boundary.
Short of a length, around middle. Yastika Bhatia hops in her crease and nudges it to the leg side for a couple of runs.
In the air...but safe! Full ball, around off. Yastika Bhatia looks to drive but it goes off the splice of the bat and just past the bowler towards mid off for a single.
SIX! BANG! Lea Tahuhu serves a short ball, around leg. Yastika Bhatia is quick to pounce on it as she pulls it behind square on the leg side for a biggie.
Play and a miss! Fuller in length, outside off. Yastika Bhatia looks to drive on the up but she misses.
Back of a length, outside off. Shafali Verma hangs back and steers it towards third man for a single.
Shorter in length, around leg. Yastika Bhatia tucks it behind square on the leg side and takes a single.
Back of a length, on off. Yastika Bhatia drives it hard towards mid on. A dot ball!
Another full ball, outside off. Yastika Bhatia looks to drive but it goes off the inside half of the bat towards square leg for a single.
Full ball, outside off. Yastika Bhatia drags it towards mid on. No run there!
Looks to play the paddle scoop, this just kept swinging away from middle. Bhatia does go across but it hits her on the body.
Into the pads yet again, this is worked through square leg for one.
This tails back in a long way from outside off, Verman whips it but to mid-wicket.
On off, this is pushed to mid off.
Back of a length, outside off. Shafali Verma steers it to third man and takes a single. She retains the strike.
Leg bye! A length ball, around leg. Yastika Bhatia misses her flick and gets hit on her pads. The ball rolls to the leg side for a leg bye.
FOUR! WHIPPED! Good-length ball, darted on the pads. Yastika Bhatia stays back and whacks it over the mid-wicket fielder. The ball races away to the fence.
On a length, around off. Shafali Verma looks to block but it goes off the outside edge towards third man for a run.
Wide! Full ball, curling away late from outside off. Shafali Verma leaves it alone and the umpire calls it as a wide.
Fuller in length, around middle. Yastika Bhatia drives it towards mid on where the fielder half-stops it and the batters take a run.
Good-length ball, angling in late from middle. Yastika Bhatia blocks it out.
Hannah Rowe to bowl from the opposite end.

Fuller in length, angling across the batter. Yastika Bhatia looks to heave it away but it goes off the toe end of the bat and just over the fielder at mid off. Yastika Bhatia and India Women are underway with a run!
Back of a length, outside off. Yastika Bhatia cuts hard bur finds the fielder at cover-point.
Full ball, around middle. Yastika Bhatia drives hard but straight to the fielder at mid on.
Well bowled! On  alength, shaping away late. Yastika Bhatia covers the line of the ball to defend.
Good-length ball, around off. Yastika Bhatia blocks it to the off side.
Just short of the slip fielder! Good-length ball, around off. Yastika Bhatia looks to poke at it and it goes off the outside edge towards the firsl slip fielder, on the bounce.
